verdict.rationale: Segment's docs pages offer first-party 'Open in ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor/Perplexity' buttons, a thin AI-oriented docs affordance for handing a page to an agent. However, probes found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at segment.com/llms.txt) and no markdown docs endpoint (HTTP 404 at /docs/.md). Missing for 10: a published llms.txt, machine-readable/markdown doc variants, documentation of what the 'Open in' buttons pass to the agent, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
